title: Align Studio
shortDescription: Align Studio explores stretching and yoga with a 3D movement guide and optional camera-based pose comparison.
longDescription: Align Studio connects my interest in movement with the camera experiments I began in AI Hands and Finger Wand. I moved from tracking fingertips to recognizing body poses, exploring camera-based pose comparison for stretching and yoga. A 3D guide and approximate pose feedback offer ways to compare movements and practice with greater awareness.

title: Modern Shuilu
shortDescription: An experiment connecting my interest in Chinese art with technology, inviting a closer look at Shuilu paintings.
longDescription: Modern Shuilu brings my interest in Chinese art together with technology and vibe coding. Through an atlas, a daily draw, and composition experiments, I explore how ancient paintings can feel approachable today while retaining their cultural significance. The project focuses on images identified in its source material as Shuilu paintings. Its carousel grew from Shuilu in Motion, while 3D Shuilu experiment explores a related character in 3D.

source.provenanceNote: Project text identifies Shuilu paintings and links to this official background source. The individual images have no verified artist, date, temple, or collection attribution in the available evidence.

title: Behind the Event
shortDescription: Work in progress: a process journal following planning, coordination, and changes behind an event.
longDescription: An evolving case study about the work behind event planning: organizing people and information, preparing the venue, communicating, and responding to changes. The process journal is the starting point; the finished case study will grow from the work carried out during the event-planning process.
